function.name: run_streaming_simulation
function.description: Runs an interactive physical simulation on HTML5 Canvas. The simulation runs in real-time on a retro oscilloscope/radar player. The Pascal program must output coordinates as JSON lines (e.g. WriteLn('{"x": 1.0, "y": 2.0}')) with a short delay (e.g. using Sleep(50) from SysUtils) to create smooth streaming curves.

title.description: The title of the physical simulation (e.g. 'Damped Pendulum', 'Lissajous Curves', 'Chaotic Attractor')

type.description: The visual display style of the Canvas Player. Use 'oscilloscope' for standard waves/particles, 'radar' for scanning/sonar sweeps, and 'graph' for progressive y(x) plots.

code.description: A self-contained Pascal program. Must print coordinates to standard output at regular intervals (using Sleep(30) or Sleep(50) from SysUtils) in JSON format. Only uses Math and SysUtils. Example: program Wave; uses Math; var t: Double; begin for t := 0 to 100 do begin WriteLn('{"x": ' + FloatToStr(t/10) + ', "y": ' + FloatToStr(sin(t/10)) + '}'); end; end.
